note: Long multi-clause stress probes annotated before calls. All objects, actions, conditions, layout and drawing identity need inspection beyond role/endpoint scoring. No expectation enters the model prompt.

cases.text: Rain flows from a roof through a gutter into a barrel while a gardener stands beside the barrel and holds a watering can.
A battery powers a motor that spins a fan; the fan blows air toward a flower, and a bee rests beside the flower.
A student stands beside a desk and holds a key. A book rests on the desk, while a cloud floats above a tree to the right of the desk.
A pump sends water through a filter into a tank. A sensor measures the water level, and a controller stops the pump when the sensor detects that the tank is full.
